notes.title: PROGRESS REPORT
notes.content:
🐑 SHEEP Progress Update
Final dev route is locked in! Feels good to see the remaining journey mapped out. Here’s where I’m at right now:

SFX & music: about 80% done, the world feels alive.

Programming: 85%, most systems are solid and I’m ironing out the last bits.

LODs & profiling: 85%, the game is running beautifully across a good range of hardware.

Dialogue: 90%, nearly all the writing’s in place.

Menus: 100%, those are wrapped up and working.

Things are really coming together and the finish line’s finally in sight. For those of you who’ve kept an eye on SHEEP along the way, I appreciate you sticking around. More soon!

notes.title: Audio update!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576765/f2c54c8cb1e88d1317230084cb77d972b3ce73bd.jpg"]

Hi everyone!

We’ve just updated the demo to include full sound effects and audio. This means you can finally experience the demo with all the atmosphere, cues, and feedback we intended.

We’d love to hear what you think—especially how the sound changes the feel of the game!

Thanks for playing and for all your feedback so far.

— B
